title: AdapTrack: Constrained Decoding without Distorting LLM's Output Intent
summary: The original AdapTrack pipeline uses constrained decoding to enforce API-usage constraints at decode time, guiding the LLM toward valid TensorFlow API completions without distorting its output intent on real-world completion samples.

This reproduction replaces the constrained decoding pipeline with unconstrained LLM API completion prompts over sampled TFv1 benchmark problems, evaluated in two prompt-configuration variants (v1, v2).
